items.title: Canonical equivalence of function fields of transcendence degree 1 with curves under dominant rational maps and with normal projective curves under morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The theorem is the backbone classification of curves by function fields (statement lines 375-387). The proof (lines 389-445) assembles the equivalence in three moves: the variety-level rational map equivalence restricted by transcendence degree, the dictionary among the four curve categories, and the construction of the fully faithful functor plus essential surjectivity through the extension lemmas and the normalization-completion construction, including the author's closing remark on the alternative order of the last two steps. H2: each move is a reference chase with one genuine construction (the normal projective model), the whole being a canonical-equivalence proof rather than a computation.
